decision_principle: Separate inference domain from source directness; admit scope-labelled direct issuer series to within-series longitudinal translation without promoting them to Indonesia-only country observations.

domains.role: Claims explicitly about Indonesia as a geography, national market, participant population, payment system, or administrative system.
families: Bank Indonesia payment evidence with distinct definitions
Tokopedia e-commerce as Indonesia-aligned direct segment evidence

series.name: Tokopedia e-commerce
series.scope_label: Indonesia-aligned segment; not a literal geographic country line

series.name: Blibli 3P
series.scope_label: includes OTA/travel through tiket.com and changing business mix

series.name: Bukalapak Group
series.scope_label: group geography broader than strict Indonesia because overseas operations remain in perimeter

revenue_basis_rule.selection_rule: Use the issuer-defined revenue measure that is consistently available across retained periods and most closely matches the transaction-measure business perimeter; preserve definition changes and structural breaks explicitly.

hard_exclusions.reason: transaction and revenue periods do not match
transaction value and revenue cover different durations

domain_b.interpretation: direct-evidence diagnostic only; not an Indonesia population or country effect

all_tier_inventory.interpretation: broader inventory diagnostic including conditional country reconstructions

prohibited_wording: Blibli Indonesia e-commerce when referring to the 3P perimeter
Bukalapak Indonesia when referring to Group-level values with overseas operations
Indonesia-wide wedge from summing issuer transaction-revenue differences
advisor_ratification_question: For RQ1, may the thesis use Tokopedia, Blibli 3P, and Bukalapak Group together as a scope-labelled direct issuer longitudinal evidence set for within-series transaction-versus-revenue growth, while reserving strict Indonesia geographic claims for Indonesia-aligned/national modules and explicitly not treating the 13 periods as one Indonesia country panel?
effect_if_ratified: update docs/CURRENT_STATUS.md with the decision and date
replace scope-pending wording with ratified labels in outward thesis artifacts
preserve existing source and directness classifications
use Domain B as the longitudinal RQ1 evidence set
retain BPS, Bank Indonesia, and institutional modules as separate Indonesia-specific evidence
rerun manuscript tables and figures under the ratified selection
unlock IL conference and journal packets that require a frozen longitudinal perimeter
